title: viola alba subsp. sepincola
intro: Viola alba subsp. sepincola, commonly known as White Violet, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the violet family, Violaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing, as well as its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of White Violet include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of White Violet for medicinal use.
